raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-17 the source sends a reversal as a separate REVERSAL record and leaves the original row as POSTED. silver_transactions keeps every POSTED row, so reversed originals are still counted and recent totals come out too high. The 40 reversals all point at originals in batches 13-14.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND txn_id NOT IN (SELECT orig_txn_id FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'REVERSAL' AND orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL)"}}
